notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI) and make REST calls to PUBLIC_API (FastAPI); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).

CHAT (FastAPI) reads + writes PostgreSQL; INTERACTION (Flask) reads + writes PostgreSQL, enqueues SQS tasks and makes API calls to LLM providers; PUBLIC_API (FastAPI) reads PostgreSQL and makes API calls to LLM providers.
Temporal workflows read PostgreSQL.
